resources.string: After your password or social sign-in, enter a code from your authenticator app.

Add a separate authenticator on a backup device before losing access to your first one. Keep access to your verified email. Losing all authenticators requires verified account recovery through support.
Sign in again to change your account protection. Your existing authenticator code may also be required.
Confirm your identity to remove %1$s. This device’s codes will stop working for this account.
This is your last authenticator. Removing it turns off two-step verification for this account.
Scan this QR code or enter the setup key in an authenticator app. Then enter its current code to finish. Protection starts only after verification succeeds.
No authenticator app could open this setup. Use the setup key in your authenticator app instead.
Setup key copied. Keep it private.
Keep this key private. DotReminder does not store it on your device after setup.
Enter the current 6-digit code from your authenticator app to continue.
Can’t access this authenticator? Choose another one below if available. Password reset does not remove two-step verification.
Authenticator added. Two-step verification is on.
Couldn’t connect. Check your connection and try again.
Too many attempts. Wait a while before trying again.
That code wasn’t accepted. Enter the current 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
Verification expired. Cancel and start again.
Your sign-in is no longer recent. Cancel and confirm your identity again.
Verify your email address before setting up an authenticator.
This account has no supported authenticator or sign-in provider. Use another enrolled method or contact support for verified recovery.
Authenticator verification is unavailable for this project. Contact support.
The signed-in account changed. Reopen account security before continuing.
Your session ended. Sign in again to check your account’s protection.
Couldn’t confirm your identity. Check your credentials and use the same account.
This account can’t add another authenticator. Review its existing methods first.
Couldn’t complete verification. Try again or reopen account security to check the current status.
Couldn’t change your password. Check your current password and try again.
